image_description: A close-up portrait of a female graduate wearing a black academic cap (mortarboard) and gown. She is holding a rolled diploma with a yellow ribbon in her left hand and touching her face/chin with her right hand. There are significant visual artifacts, including ghosting/double-exposure effects on the hands and face, and faint watermark-like text overlay across the center.

The visible upper portion of the gown shows a standard front opening and symmetrical lapels/shoulders.
The fabric around the shoulders and arms appears loose and non-form-fitting, consistent with gown construction.
